mission_statement: The Undergraduate Economics Society (UES) is the premier student organization dedicated to bridging theoretical economics with real-world application, quantitative research, and career leadership.
vision_statement: To cultivate an inclusive, intellectually vibrant community where undergraduate students master economic principles, address pressing global challenges, and launch distinguished careers across academia, public policy, tech, and financial markets.

pillars.title: Academic Excellence
pillars.description: Comprehensive study groups, peer tutoring, econometrics workshops, and faculty roundtable discussions.

pillars.title: National Case Competitions
pillars.description: Host of the prestigious UES Annual Economics Case Competition, connecting top student analysts with industry judges.

pillars.title: Career Launchpad
pillars.description: Exclusive recruitment events with premier investment banks, economic consultancies, central banks, and tech firms.

pillars.title: Policy & Research Journal
pillars.description: Publication of the Undergraduate Economic Review, showcasing peer-reviewed student research and policy analyses.

history.event: UES founded with 25 charter members to foster undergraduate economic research.
Launched the First Annual National Undergraduate Case Competition.
Expanded career mentorship network connecting over 500 alumni in global finance & tech.
Established $10,000 annual case competition endowment sponsored by top economic consulting firms.
